nodes.title: SG-8.2 · Delete dead code and enforce size and import rules
nodes.body:
Context: SG-8 performance pass. The tree has no source file over 200 lines today (largest is game/frontend/src/art/roomFurniture.ts at 162) and no import from game/src into game/frontend, but nothing enforces either rule. Some exports and one component (RoundBadge.tsx) are unused. Desired behaviour: dead code is deleted with no test deleted or skipped, and two unit tests fail when the rules are broken. Expected result: both suites stay green and the rules are guarded. Why: keeps the refactor from regressing.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the tree, when unused exports and RoundBadge.tsx are removed, then npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/ with no test deleted or skipped
- Given a source file over 200 lines under game/src or game/frontend/src, when the size test runs, then it fails naming the file
- Given a file in game/src that imports a path containing frontend, when the boundary test runs, then it fails naming the file


## Scope
- In scope: Unused export and file removal
- In scope: Size-limit unit test
- In scope: Import-boundary unit test
- Out of scope: SG-8.1 performance work
- Out of scope: SG-8.3 context.md and GDD
- Out of scope: backend/
- Out of scope: New features or art changes
- Preserve: Boys-room gameplay
- Preserve: Phaser pinned ~3.90.0 and its guard test
- Preserve: Zustand store as sole GameState owner
- Preserve: frontend/src/api/client.ts endpoints and payloads


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- No test is deleted or skipped; tests that pinned internals are rewritten against behaviour
- No source file over 200 lines; game/src never imports game/frontend
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- Both new tests pass and the full suites and typechecks in game/ and game/frontend/ are green


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Export countLines(text: string): number returning the number of newline-separated lines (a trailing newline does not add a line), and overLimit(files: { path: string; lines: number }[], max: number): string[] returning paths with lines > max.
steps.code:
export function countLines(t: string): number { return t === '' ? 0 : t.replace(/\n$/, '').split('\n').length; }
export function overLimit(f: { path: string; lines: number }[], max: number): string[] { return f.filter((x) => x.lines > max).map((x) => x.path); }

nodes.description: Create a pure function used by the boundary scan test.
acceptance_criteria: frontendImports returns specifiers containing a frontend path segment
Handles import, export-from and import()

steps.action: Export frontendImports(text: string): string[] that collects every specifier from `from '<s>'`, `import '<s>'` and `import('<s>')` and returns those matching /(^|\/)frontend(\/|$)/.
steps.code:
const RE = /(?:from\s+|import\s*\(?\s*)['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g;
export function frontendImports(t: string): string[] { return [...t.matchAll(RE)].map((m) => m[1]).filter((s) => /(^|\/)frontend(\/|$)/.test(s)); }
